data.name: Label1.Text
data.value: You are about to upgrade to the latest version of the scenario's underlying DB. New units added to the scenario will be defined as per the latest DB version. Existing units will retain their current inventory of mounts/sensors/stores etc. but the performance characteristics of their equipment will be updated as per the latest DB version. DO THIS ONLY IF YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING.

data.name: Label2.Text
data.value: Deep-rebuild not only refreshes the properties of each platform and of each of its components, but also the platform's component inventory (which weapons, sensors etc. it has). It also completely resets damage status, fuel status etc. Each platform is effectively re-initialized to its pristine "fresh from the DB" state.

data.name: Label5.Text
data.value: If any changes/customizations have been made to a platform in the scenario, they will need to be re-applied either manually or via an INI config file. When you select Apply INI File, you will be prompted to select the INI file to apply to the scenario.

data.name: DarkLabel2.Text
data.value: Aircraft AI evasion changed significantly in CMO v1.05+. This may cause aircraft to escape missiles launched from long range. You can set the WRA default launch range to limit missile launches against aircraft to shorter ranges.

data.name: DarkLabel1.Text
data.value: Unit 'Observe-Orient-Decide-Act' (OODA) reaction times were increased in DBv494+. If you are migrating from an older DB to DB494+ you may wish to preserve OODA values for existing units to preserve scenario balance.
